title: Chief of Staff with Security Clearance
description: Job Number: R0246049 Chief of Staff The Opportunity: As a Chief of Staff, you understand the complexities of supporting a project from concept to completion. Many programs demand a significant investment of limited resources, and it's essential to keep the work on a productive path. That's why we need you-an experienced program and project management specialist who brings clear communication, steady judgment, and reliable support to fast-moving efforts.
